controls.title: Access Control Policy and Procedures
controls.description: The agency shall develop, document, and disseminate an access control policy and procedures.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: The agency shall manage information system accounts, including establishing, activating, modifying, reviewing, disabling, and removing accounts.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.description: The information system shall enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.

controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.description: The information system shall enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of FTI within the system and between interconnected systems.

controls.title: Separation of Duties
controls.description: The agency shall separate duties of individuals as necessary to prevent malevolent activity.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.description: The agency shall employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users which are necessary.

controls.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
controls.description: The information system shall enforce a limit of consecutive invalid logon attempts within a specified time period and automatically lock the account.

controls.title: Session Termination
controls.description: The information system shall automatically terminate a user session after conditions defined by the agency have been met.

controls.title: Remote Access
controls.description: The agency shall authorize, monitor, and control all remote access methods to the information system.

controls.title: Wireless Access
controls.description: The agency shall authorize, monitor, and control wireless access to the information system.

controls.title: Use of External Information Systems
controls.description: The agency shall establish terms and conditions governing the use of external information systems.

controls.title: Security Awareness Training
controls.description: The agency shall provide basic security awareness training to all information system users as part of initial training and at least annually thereafter.

controls.title: Role-Based Security Training
controls.description: The agency shall provide role-based security training to personnel with assigned security roles and responsibilities.

controls.title: Audit Events
controls.description: The information system shall generate audit records for specified events including successful and unsuccessful logon attempts, and other security-relevant events.

controls.title: Content of Audit Records
controls.description: The information system shall produce audit records that contain sufficient information to establish what events occurred, when, where, the source, outcome, and identity of individuals/subjects associated with each event.

controls.title: Audit Storage Capacity
controls.description: The agency shall allocate audit record storage capacity and configure auditing to reduce the likelihood of such capacity being exceeded.

controls.title: Response to Audit Processing Failures
controls.description: The information system shall alert appropriate organizational officials in the event of an audit processing failure and take defined additional actions.

controls.title: Audit Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.description: The agency shall review and analyze information system audit records on a regular basis for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity.

controls.title: Audit Reduction and Report Generation
controls.description: The information system shall provide an audit reduction and report generation capability that supports on-demand audit review, analysis, and reporting requirements.

controls.title: Time Stamps
controls.description: The information system shall use internal system clocks to generate time stamps for audit records.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.description: The information system shall protect audit information and audit tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.description: The agency shall develop, document, and maintain a current baseline configuration of the information system.

controls.title: Configuration Change Control
controls.description: The agency shall authorize, document, and control changes to the information system.

controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.description: The agency shall configure the information system to provide only essential capabilities and prohibit or restrict the use of specified functions, ports, protocols, and services.

controls.title: Contingency Plan
controls.description: The agency shall develop a contingency plan for the information system that identifies essential missions and business functions.

controls.title: Information System Backup
controls.description: The agency shall conduct backups of user-level and system-level information at defined frequencies.

controls.title: Information System Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.description: The agency shall provide for the recovery and reconstitution of the information system to a known state after a disruption.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: The information system shall uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users or processes acting on behalf of users.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description: The agency shall manage information system authenticators by defining initial authenticator content, establishing administrative procedures, and requiring changes when authenticators are compromised.

controls.title: Incident Response Policy and Procedures
controls.description: The agency shall develop and implement an incident response capability for the information system that includes preparation, detection, analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.

controls.title: Incident Reporting
controls.description: The agency shall report suspected or confirmed FTI data incidents to the appropriate IRS office within 24 hours of discovery.

controls.title: Media Protection Policy
controls.description: The agency shall restrict access to FTI on digital and non-digital media to authorized individuals only.

controls.title: Media Sanitization
controls.description: The agency shall sanitize information system media prior to disposal, release, or reuse.

controls.title: Physical Access Authorizations
controls.description: The agency shall authorize, monitor, and control physical access to the facility where the information system resides.

controls.title: Physical Access Control
controls.description: The agency shall control physical access to information system distribution and transmission lines within organizational facilities.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: The information system shall monitor and control communications at the external boundary and at key internal boundaries within the system.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.description: The information system shall protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted FTI using FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic mechanisms.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.description: The information system shall protect the confidentiality and integrity of FTI at rest.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.description: The agency shall identify, report, and correct information system flaws in a timely manner.

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection
controls.description: The agency shall implement malicious code protection mechanisms at information system entry and exit points.
